title: NDT Wi-Fi 7 MLO Security - Unified Dashboard
description: Unified view of all NDT experiments: raw telemetry, GCN attack predictions, confidence scores, and per-experiment comparison. Filter by Run Selector to scope all panels to a specific run group.

list.name: Attack Detections
list.rawSql: SELECT ts_start as time, CONCAT('Attack: ', segment_id, ' exp=', experiment_id, ' conf=', ROUND(confidence::numeric, 2)) as text, 'attack' as tags FROM gcn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' AND prediction = 1 ORDER BY ts_start

list.name: Experiment Starts
list.rawSql: SELECT MIN(ts) as time, CONCAT('Start: ', experiment_id) as text, 'experiment' as tags FROM metrics WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' GROUP BY experiment_id ORDER BY MIN(ts)

list.name: run_prefix
list.label: Run Selector
list.description: Filter all panels to a run group (YYYYMMDD-HHMM prefix) or a specific legacy experiment ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN experiment_id ~ '^\d{8}-\d{4}' THEN regexp_replace(experiment_id, '^(\d{8}-\d{4}).*', '\1') ELSE experiment_id END AS run_prefix FROM metrics ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: model_version
list.label: Model Version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_version FROM gcn_predictions ORDER BY model_version DESC

list.name: experiment_selector
list.label: Experiment
list.description: Select a specific experiment for the drill-down view at the bottom. Scoped to the active Run Selector.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' ORDER BY experiment_id

panels.title: Total Segments
panels.description: Total GCN predictions (one per 256-window segment) for the selected run and model version

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}'

panels.title: Attacks Detected
panels.description: Number of segments classified as attack (prediction=1)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' AND prediction = 1

panels.title: Attack Rate %
panels.description: Percentage of segments classified as attacks

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}'

panels.title: Avg Confidence
panels.description: Average prediction confidence (0=uncertain, 1=certain). High for both normal and attack when correctly classified.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}'

panels.title: Avg Inference (ms)
panels.description: Average GCN model inference time per segment. Expected range 1-20ms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(inference_time_ms)::numeric, 1) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' AND inference_time_ms IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Active Model
panels.description: Most recently used model version in predictions for this run

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version as value FROM gcn_predictions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Experiments in Run
panels.description: Number of distinct experiments matching the Run Selector

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT experiment_id) as value FROM metrics WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%'

panels.title: Run Time Range
panels.description: Earliest and latest simulation timestamps for the selected run

targets.rawSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' to ' || TO_CHAR(MAX(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') as value FROM metrics WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%'

panels.title: Attack Detection Timeline (0=Normal, 1=Attack)
panels.description: Binary prediction per segment over time. Green=normal experiments, red=attack-pos, orange=attack-neg.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_start AS "time", prediction::float as value, experiment_id as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' ORDER BY ts_start, experiment_id

panels.title: Prediction Confidence Over Time
panels.description: Confidence score per segment (0=uncertain, 1=certain). High confidence for both normal and attack indicates clear signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_start AS "time", confidence as value, CONCAT(experiment_id, ' (pred=', prediction, ')') as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Attack Probability (Class 1) Over Time
panels.description: Raw GCN output probability for the attack class (probabilities[1]). Complements confidence score.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_start AS "time", (probabilities->>1)::numeric as value, experiment_id as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Avg Backoff Slots (Key Attack Indicator)
panels.description: Primary attack indicator. Normal ~9-10 slots. Positive attack ~345 (+3500% priority queue monopolization). Negative attack ~2.3 (-77% backoff suppression).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'avg_backoff_slots' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Network Throughput (Mbps)
panels.description: Aggregate network throughput. Normal ~304 Mbps. Attack scenarios show ~31% reduction (~209 Mbps).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'net_throughput_mbps' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Packet Loss Ratio
panels.description: Network quality: Normal ~2.5%, Attack-neg up to 48%, Attack-pos ~33%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'net_packet_loss_ratio' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Average Packet Delay (ms)
panels.description: End-to-end packet delivery latency. Increases under attack conditions due to contention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'net_avg_delay_ms' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Average Jitter (ms)
panels.description: Delay variation. Higher jitter indicates contention instability from backoff manipulation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'net_avg_jitter_ms' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Channel Busy Ratio
panels.description: Channel utilization (0-1). Normal ~0.79. Attack-neg ~0.89 (overloaded). Attack-pos ~0.41 (monopolized by attacker).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'channel_busy_ratio' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: MAC Layer Retransmissions
panels.description: Cumulative MAC retransmission count. Elevated retransmissions indicate collision and contention from backoff manipulation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'mac_total_retrans' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Active Network Flows
panels.description: Count of active flows in the network (typical range 0-5). Shows network activity level.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name = 'net_active_flows' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Attack Rate by Experiment (%)
panels.description: Attack detection rate per experiment in the selected run. 0% = all normal, 100% = all attack.

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id as metric, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' GROUP BY experiment_id ORDER BY experiment_id

panels.title: Avg Confidence by Experiment
panels.description: Average GCN prediction confidence per experiment. High confidence (either direction) means model is certain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id as metric, ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric, 3) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' GROUP BY experiment_id ORDER BY experiment_id

panels.title: Network Metrics Summary (Per Experiment)
panels.description: Statistical summary of 6 key metrics for all experiments in the selected run. Enables side-by-side comparison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id as "Experiment", metric_name as "Metric", ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 2) as "Avg", ROUND(STDDEV(value)::numeric, 2) as "StdDev", ROUND(MIN(value)::numeric, 2) as "Min", ROUND(MAX(value)::numeric, 2) as "Max" FROM metrics WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND metric_name IN ('avg_backoff_slots', 'net_throughput_mbps', 'net_packet_loss_ratio', 'net_avg_delay_ms', 'net_avg_jitter_ms', 'channel_busy_ratio') AND entity_id = 'network' GROUP BY experiment_id, metric_name ORDER BY metric_name, experiment_id

panels.title: GCN Inference Time per Segment (ms)
panels.description: Time taken by the GCN model to classify each segment. Expected range 1-20ms. Spikes may indicate resource contention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts_start AS "time", inference_time_ms as value, experiment_id as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_start) AND experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' AND inference_time_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts_start

panels.title: Prediction Distribution (Normal vs Attack)
panels.description: Overall proportion of normal vs attack predictions for the selected run and model version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN prediction = 0 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Attack' END as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' GROUP BY prediction ORDER BY prediction

panels.title: Model Performance Summary
panels.description: Key aggregated metrics for the selected run and model version

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value, 'Total Segs' as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}'
SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(AVG(confidence)::numeric * 100, 1), '%') as value, 'Avg Conf' as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}'

SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(AVG(inference_time_ms)::numeric, 1), ' ms') as value, 'Avg Infer' as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' AND inference_time_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT model_version as value, 'Model' as metric FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Recent GCN Predictions (Last 200)
panels.description: Latest segment-level GCN predictions. Confidence displayed as gauge. Prediction colored green=normal, red=attack.

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id AS "Experiment", entity_id AS "Entity", segment_id AS "Segment", ts_start AS "Start Time", ts_end AS "End Time", CASE WHEN prediction = 0 THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Attack' END AS "Prediction", ROUND(confidence::numeric, 3) AS "Confidence", CONCAT('[', ROUND((probabilities->>0)::numeric, 3), ', ', ROUND((probabilities->>1)::numeric, 3), ']') AS "Probabilities [N, A]", ROUND(inference_time_ms::numeric, 1) AS "Inference (ms)", model_version AS "Model", created_at AS "Detected At" FROM gcn_predictions WHERE experiment_id LIKE '${run_prefix}%' AND model_version ~ '${model_version:regex}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Model Summary — What These Numbers Mean

options.content:
**Total Segs** — Number of 256-window graph segments classified by the GCN. Each segment = ~25 seconds of simulation.

**Avg Conf** — Model certainty (0–100%). High confidence for *both* Normal and Attack means the model is sure. Low confidence indicates ambiguous signal.

**Avg Infer** — GCN inference latency per segment. Target: <20 ms. Spikes indicate CPU contention.

**Model** — Active GCN version. `v2.0.0` = pipeline-trained on 284 balanced scenarios (normal + both attack types).

panels.title: Drill-Down: Metric Evolution for Selected Experiment
Avg Backoff Slots — Over Time
panels.description: How backoff slot count evolved during the selected experiment. Normal stays ~9-10. Positive attack rises to ~345. Negative attack drops to ~2.3. Use the 'Experiment' dropdown above to select one experiment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${experiment_selector}%' AND metric_name = 'avg_backoff_slots' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Network Throughput (Mbps) — Over Time
panels.description: How throughput evolved during the simulation. Attack scenarios show a sustained drop (~31%) compared to normal baseline of ~304 Mbps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${experiment_selector}%' AND metric_name = 'net_throughput_mbps' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Packet Loss Ratio — Over Time
panels.description: Packet loss progression during the experiment. Normal ~2.5%. Attack-neg up to 48%. Attack-pos ~33%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${experiment_selector}%' AND metric_name = 'net_packet_loss_ratio' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Average Packet Delay (ms) — Over Time
panels.description: Latency evolution during the experiment. Attack scenarios increase delay due to MAC contention and retransmissions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${experiment_selector}%' AND metric_name = 'net_avg_delay_ms' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id

panels.title: Channel Busy Ratio — Over Time
panels.description: Channel utilization across the simulation. Normal ~79%. Attack-neg overloads to ~89%. Attack-pos drops to ~41% (attacker monopolizes the channel, others back off).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value, experiment_id FROM metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND experiment_id LIKE '${experiment_selector}%' AND metric_name = 'channel_busy_ratio' AND entity_id = 'network' ORDER BY ts, experiment_id
